title.narrative: CCFN Institutional Capacity Strengthening project phase II

description.narrative:
The project will support CCFN to diversify its resource-base, through awareness-creation activities that will sensitize Catholic faithful on the need to support the programmes of CCFN. This will allow CCFN reach out to more dioceses with needed funds and capacity-building for development and humanitarian assistance projects.
The project will enhance CCFN’s visibility and strategic resource mobilisation strategies. The project aims at building a dignified and sustainable National Caritas in Nigeria. Also, the institutional capacity building will assist CCFN to strengthen its own support base so as to be able to retain a core complement of skilled staff to work with the partners. Furthermore, by the end of this project; there will be significant increase in CCFN’s capabilities to take lead in CAFOD’s interventions within Nigeria. CAFOD will continuously work with CCFN to improve the Think Tank Committee of the Catholic Secretariat of Nigeria. In other to further the work of CCFN on advocacy, CAFOD will facilitate the training of Think Tank Coordinator on Advanced Policy and Advocacy Engagement.
CAFOD shall facilitate the strengthening of CCFN’s systems, processes and practices as an institution for quality service delivery to the Nigerian citizens. This will be done through the accompanier approach, direct project funding, sharing of relevant information, linking, networking and collaborative working together. The Outcome of this project; 1. The Church in Nigeria increases local support for relief and development efforts through fund-raising activities. 2. CCFN’s Gender and governance programming improved; 3. JDPC and CWSI (Partners) teams implement good quality governance and gender programmes
